responsibility: Computes and maintains summary register statistics for RTL, derived largely from df results. It fills REG_N_SETS/REG_N_REFS and reg_info fields such as death counts, calls crossed, basic-block locality, frequencies, and setjmp-crossing information by scanning blocks backwards with liveness information, and provides allocation, teardown, query, and dump support for passes that need compact register-usage summaries rather than full df chains.
